title: DOCI Inbox — Add Request
description: Request body for POST /api/inbox.php?action=add. Free-form quick capture. The first non-empty line becomes the title (truncated to 80 chars). Files land at files/inbox/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.md with doc_type='inbox'. Use ?action=promote with {guid, target} to convert into a structured document.

content.description: Free-form text. Markdown is rendered if the body contains markdown; plain text is fine. The first non-empty line is extracted as the title.

oneOf.description: Comma-separated tag list; will be split and per-tag-validated against `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$`.

source.description: Optional caller identifier for analytics. Stored in created_by if no Remote-User is set.
